source_basis.source_implemented_method: two-dimensional precomputed steady-state flux tables with bilinear interpolation
source_basis.source_discussion_extension: Ross explicitly notes the table-size/accuracy tradeoff, that smaller intervals at high water contents may improve accuracy, and that quadratic interpolation with smaller tables may offer similar accuracy at higher lookup cost.
source_basis.SWAP5_variant_status: qualification-only bounded-cost representation experiment, not claimed to be the exact Ross 2011 implementation

representation.axis: uniform x grid between logit(S(-10000 cm)) and logit(S(-1 cm))
representation.stored_value: steady downward-positive Darcy flux q in float64 cm/day
representation.interpolation: tensor-product quadratic Lagrange interpolation using a bounded 3x3 stencil
representation.boundary_stencil: one-sided nearest valid 3-node stencil, no extrapolation beyond the frozen envelope
representation.runtime_indexing: analytic uniform-grid index after two logit transforms
representation.runtime_complexity_per_face: O(1): two coordinate transforms, bounded index arithmetic, nine table reads and fixed interpolation arithmetic
representation.selection_rule: Choose the smallest node count passing all B1-B6 characterization criteria. Do not change representation or density after holdout freeze.

characterization.ordinary_probe_generator: deterministic scrambled Sobol points mapped first to the physical S envelope
characterization.special_equal_head_heads: negative geometric spacing from -1 cm through -10000 cm
characterization.hydrostatic_probe_rule: h_below=h_above+10 cm where both endpoints remain inside the envelope
characterization.monotonicity_diagnostic: At ordinary probes, perturb each transformed endpoint coordinate locally and report violations of expected q increase with upper wetness and q decrease with lower wetness; diagnostic only, not an added post-hoc hard gate.

B6_memory.formula: 8*N*N bytes q table plus 32 bytes transform/index metadata; the uniform axis itself is not stored

scope_guard: Success qualifies one unsaturated homogeneous B01 face class only. It does not qualify material generalisation, saturation switching, heterogeneity, transient timestep accuracy, bottom boundary, groundwater, processes, MultiSWAP or FullRichards equivalence.
